rules: No generic Inter font. 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic' is mandatory for a professional, trustworthy financial appearance.
Use 'tabular-nums' utility strictly on all accounting tables, prices, and stats to align digits vertically.
Heading hierarchy must not jump more than 2 Tailwind scales.

forbidden: pure transparent backgrounds on overlapping surfaces

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-zinc-200. Used extensively for dense grid layouts to clearly separate data.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. shadow-sm for cards. shadow-md for dropdowns/modals. Avoid heavy ambient shadows to maintain a clean clinical look.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-md (4px) universally. Avoid excessive roundness (like rounded-xl or full) to maintain professional density.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid only. No Glassmorphism for financial data to prevent visual refraction.

general.sidebar_nav: Right-aligned in RTL mode (w-64). Solid white background, 1px border on the left (border-l).
general.topbar: Sticky h-16, white bg, solid bottom border. Contains user profile, shift status, and branch name.

super_admin_dashboard.content: Bento Grid (High Density). Top row: 4 stat cards (Total Shops, Active Subs, Revenue, etc.). Middle row: Wide Chart (Subscriptions over time) + Top Shops List. Bottom: Dense data table of all tenants.
super_admin_dashboard.spacing: Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) to maximize data visibility.

shop_pos_screen.structure: Full screen, no sidebar. Minimal top header.
shop_pos_screen.content: Split layout. Right side (70%): Product Grid with category tabs above it. Left side (30%): Current Cart / Invoice. (Complies with RTL reading direction & user preference).
shop_pos_screen.cart_details: Left side fixed height. Top: Customer selection. Middle: Scrollable list of cart items (Name, Qty (+/-), Price). Bottom: Total, Discount, Tax, and large Checkout action buttons (Cash, Card, Hold).
shop_pos_screen.keyboard_shortcuts: Must display shortcut keys (e.g., [F1] for Cash, [Ctrl+Z] for Undo) inside the buttons as small overlines.

accounting_data_tables.structure: Standard Dashboard layout with Sidebar and Topbar.
accounting_data_tables.table_rules: Dense padding (py-2 px-3), stripped rows (odd:bg-zinc-50/50), sticky headers, right-aligned text, left-aligned numbers.

motion.modals: Fade in and slight slide-up (translate-y-2 to 0)
motion.lists: Extremely fast staggered fade-in for product grid items (under 150ms). Do not make cashiers wait for animations.
motion.rules: Disable all slow animations on the POS screen. Speed is critical for cashiers.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA guidelines. Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text.
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard: Full keyboard navigability for the POS screen. Up/Down arrows for cart navigation.
accessibility_and_testing.rtl: Use HTML dir='rtl'. Use Tailwind logical properties (e.g., ms-4, pe-2, border-s) instead of physical (ml-4, pr-2, border-l).
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid. Examples: data-testid='pos-product-item', data-testid='checkout-button', data-testid='tenant-row'.

component_instructions.framework: React JS (.js files). Use Tailwind CSS. Shadcn UI primitives customized for dense data.
component_instructions.data_tables: Build robust tabular data views. Do not use generic card layouts for accounting data.
component_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Form/Input components. Labels must be on the right (RTL alignment).
component_instructions.dropdowns: Must have solid white background (bg-white) and a border. No transparent backgrounds.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You are building a B2B SaaS POS and Accounting system in Arabic (RTL).
Always apply dir='rtl' and lang='ar' to the main HTML/root container.
Avoid AI slop: no purple gradients, no generic Inter font, no arbitrary centered text (align text based on RTL natural flow, usually right-aligned).
Implement keyboard shortcuts visually on the POS screen (e.g., F1 for Pay, Ctrl+F for Search).
Use solid backgrounds for all overlapping elements (modals, dropdowns, sticky headers). Never use transparent/glass for financial apps.
Use 'tabular-nums' for all prices, quantities, and accounting data.
Every button and input MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute for testing.
Spacing should be tight and dense (Shadcn default or smaller) because accountants and cashiers need to see maximum data on one screen.
Do not use placeholder image URLs. Since this is a POS, products should use generic colored box avatars with the first letter of the product if an image is missing.
